title: Process for Adapting Language Models to Society (PALMS) with Values-Targeted Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Co-occurrence evaluations generating text using gendered pronouns (e.g., she/her, he/him) and analyzing the most common descriptive words associated with each gender.
Co-occurrence evaluations generating text using religious group names (e.g., Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Hinduism) and analyzing the top descriptive words associated with each religion.

Co-occurrence evaluations generating text using racial and ethnic categories (e.g., Black, White, East Asian, Hispanic, South Asian) and analyzing the most frequent descriptive words associated with each group.
